evidence: Labeled Validation, modifies `src/validation.h` and `src/validation.cpp` to route block header future-time and IBD tip-age checks through `ChainstateManager::Now()`.
rationale: Reroutes validation time checks through `ChainstateManager` to isolate validation state from global time and eliminates an intermittent test race in `chainstatemanager_ibd_exit_after_loading_blocks`. It improves the testability and isolation of validation without changing consensus rules or node-level validation behavior.
